post.description:
Replace the active phone atomically, advancing accessible resource epochs.

Fresh authorized-device grants are required for future writes. Authentication
never returns resource keys or decrypts an encrypted recovery snapshot.

post.description: Store an FCM token for the authenticated device.

Send an opaque sync_available wake-up to all other active family devices.

Payload sent to FCM: {"type": "sync_available"} only.
No event titles, child names, family identifiers, or any family content
are included (ADR-026).
